label: BigFields
description: Karoo data fields in digits as large as the screen allows, for riders who would rather not have to wear reading glasses on the bike. Four Big Page fields fill a whole data page with one or two values in rows of equal height; 32 single fields read native Karoo values, more read other extensions (BetterETA, BoschData). Numbers are fitted to the real outline of the digits in a condensed font: on a Karoo 3, 180 px digits on a two-value page against 130 px for native fields. Six styles with zone colours for heart rate and power.
releaseNotes: 1.1: fields from other extensions in large digits (BetterETA: arrival, time to go, next point, the next climb's top, Way Home; BoschData: bike battery, rider power, BEStie board battery). Small cells keep their digits while navigating, and captions that do not fit a half cell are shortened instead of cut. Settings are kept on update.
